use net:System.Math as NetMath
use net:System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex as Rx
use js:"node:path/posix" as path
use go:strings as gstr

unit m, g
unit km = 1000 m
unit kg = 1000 g
currency EUR, SEK

record LegIn {
    route: Text
    dx_km: Float
    dy_km: Float
    weight_g: Float
    zone: Text
}

record QuoteReq {
    eur_to_sek: Float
    max_sek: Int
    legs: List[LegIn]
}

fn is_valid_zone(zone: Text) -> Bool pure =
    zone == "SE" or zone == "EU" or zone == "NON-EU"

fn is_valid_leg(depot_ok: Bool, zone: Text) -> Bool pure =
    depot_ok and is_valid_zone(zone)

fn distance_multiplier(dist: Float[km]) -> Float pure =
    let d = scalar(dist) in
    cases d {
        <= 50.0 => 1.0
        <= 200.0 => 1.15
        else => 1.35
    }

fn is_heavy(weight: Float[kg]) -> Bool pure =
    scalar(weight) >= 10.0

fn is_long_haul(dist: Float[km]) -> Bool pure =
    scalar(dist) > 100.0

fn is_vip_depot(depot: Text, zone: Text) -> Bool pure =
    depot == "sto-01" and zone == "SE"

fn heavy_surcharge(weight: Float[kg], vip_exempt: Bool) -> Float[EUR] pure =
    if vip_exempt then 0.0 as EUR
    else if is_heavy(weight) then 12.0 as EUR
    else 0.0 as EUR

fn leg_fee(dist: Float[km], weight: Float[kg], vip_exempt: Bool) -> Float[EUR] pure =
    let base = (5.0 + 0.5 * scalar(dist) + 2.0 * scalar(weight)) as EUR in
    base * distance_multiplier(dist) + heavy_surcharge(weight, vip_exempt)

fn apply_zone_adjustment(fee: Float[EUR], zone: Text) -> Float[EUR] pure =
    if zone == "SE" then fee * 0.9
    else if zone == "NON-EU" then fee + (15.0 as EUR)
    else fee

fn eur_to_sek_amount(amount: Float[EUR], rate: Float) -> Float[SEK] pure =
    (scalar(amount) * rate) as SEK

fn eval_leg(leg: LegIn) =
    let norm = path.normalize(leg.route) in
    let depot = path.basename(norm) in
    let zone = gstr.ToUpper(gstr.TrimSpace(leg.zone)) in
    let valid = is_valid_leg(Rx.IsMatch(depot, "^[a-z]{3}-[0-9]{2}$"), zone) in
    let dist_km = NetMath.Sqrt(leg.dx_km * leg.dx_km + leg.dy_km * leg.dy_km) as km in
    let weight_kg = (leg.weight_g as g) to kg in
    let heavy = is_heavy(weight_kg) in
    let vip_exempt = is_vip_depot(depot, zone) and heavy in
    let long_haul = is_long_haul(dist_km) in
    let fee_eur = apply_zone_adjustment(leg_fee(dist_km, weight_kg, vip_exempt), zone) in
    let fee_eur_cents = round_even(scalar(fee_eur) * 100.0) in
    record {
        depot
        zone
        valid
        heavy
        vip_exempt
        long_haul
        dist_km
        weight_kg
        fee_eur
        fee_eur_cents
    }

let req: QuoteReq = from_json(stdin_text())
let evaluated = [eval_leg(leg) for leg in req.legs]
let valid_evaluated = [leg for leg in evaluated where leg.valid]
let long_haul_pairs = count adjacent prev, curr in valid_evaluated where prev.long_haul and curr.long_haul
let summary = summarize leg in evaluated {
    legs: count
    valid_legs: count where leg.valid
    heavy_legs: count where leg.valid and leg.heavy
    customs_legs: count where leg.valid and leg.zone == "NON-EU"
    vip_exempt: count where leg.valid and leg.vip_exempt
    total_km: sum leg.dist_km where leg.valid
    total_eur: sum leg.fee_eur where leg.valid
    max_leg_eur_cents: max leg.fee_eur_cents where leg.valid default 0
}
let total_eur = summary.total_eur + ((25.0 * to_float(long_haul_pairs)) as EUR)
let total_m = round_even(scalar(summary.total_km to m))
let total_eur_cents = round_even(scalar(total_eur) * 100.0)
let total_sek = round_even(scalar(eur_to_sek_amount(total_eur, req.eur_to_sek)))
let within_cap = total_sek <= req.max_sek
let out = record {
    legs: summary.legs
    valid_legs: summary.valid_legs
    total_m
    total_eur_cents
    total_sek
    heavy_legs: summary.heavy_legs
    customs_legs: summary.customs_legs
    long_haul_pairs
    vip_exempt: summary.vip_exempt
    within_cap
    max_leg_eur_cents: summary.max_leg_eur_cents
}
print json_encode(out)
